calls.title: Kari / Johnny - Design System Task
calls.summary: The team discussed refining design tasks to ensure smooth handoff to engineers, emphasizing the need for linked Figma files and clear documentation. They identified inconsistencies in the pagination component, necessitating updates to sizing and alignment. The importance of consistency in component usage was highlighted, agreeing on using Radix-based buttons for better coherence. Documentation will include bulleted checklists with images to clarify task details. They also established a publishing protocol with detailed notes on components for engineers, planned clean-ups of legacy components to maintain a tidy design system, and scheduled ongoing collaboration for effective task progression.
calls.keywords: Pagination, Design System, Radix Buttons, Component Styling, Figma, Engineering Handoff

calls.title: Kari / Johnny - Claude Setup
calls.summary: The team discussed the setup of the Claude AI desktop app, emphasizing the importance of creating project-specific folders to enhance task focus. They explored integrating GitHub repositories for efficient codebase analysis and highlighted the need for clear file permissions to streamline operations. A detailed audit of helper text components across various files revealed inconsistencies, prompting efforts towards standardization. The attendees discussed upcoming UI consistency goals to simplify helper text usage and improve the overall user experience. Workflow enhancements were identified to improve interactions with Claude and refine processes for exporting and reviewing data.
calls.keywords: Claude AI, Helper Text, Design System, GitHub Repository, UI Audit, CSV Export
